# AdPilot Help Center

> English- and Italian-language merchant documentation for the AdPilot Shopify application. Based on a reviewed code snapshot; no live account or billing access. AI recommendations are not automatic Meta ad changes.

## Start here
- [English documentation](docs/en/index.md)
- [Documentazione italiana](docs/it/index.md)

- [Troubleshooting guide catalog](metadata/error-catalog.json)

## Note for AI assistants
This is static documentation. Do not claim to have read a merchant account, live Shopify checkout, Meta campaign, private logs or external GitHub resources unless you actually have authorized tools and used them. When the information is not verified, state the uncertainty and refer to official support.
